name: Clay Guardian
description: The clay golem is a construct created from clay and infused with arcane magic. These formidable golems become further empowered by being in the proximity to channeled spells.

actions.name: Smash
actions.description: The clay guardian attacks a creature with their fists, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target becomes dazed.

actions.name: Tail Sweep
actions.description: After using the Smash Action on a creature, the clay guardian makes an attack with their tail at a different creature, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Manaseeker
actions.description: In response to a spell being channeled within 4 units of the clay guardian, it moves to an adjacent tile to the origin of the spell.

actions.name: Grasp
actions.description: The clay guardian makes a special grapple against a creature that is medium or smaller, that causes the trapped condition. If the clay guardian has two creatures trapped this way, it can no longer use it's Smash Action.

actions.name: Squeeze
actions.description: The clay guardian clamps their grip down on any creature it has trapped with it's Grasp Action, dealing true damage.

traits.name: Ether Sponge
traits.description: When a spell is channeled within 4 units of the clay guardian, it's next Smash Action is empowered to a degree based on the level of the spell. A beginner spell adds 1d4 arcane damage, novice 2d6 and 2d10 for a journeyman or higher.
